title: results.json
description: The last result of every test that has been executed. Written by the full run and updated by every run-tests: results of the tests that ran are replaced, the others are kept.

error.description: Set when the last execution failed as a whole (e.g. the tests didn't compile), so no test has a fresh result. Removed by the next successful execution.

message.description: Shown on every test of the run. May span several lines, e.g. the compiler output.

results.description: At most one result per testId.

status.description: `failed`: an assertion failed or the code under test threw. `error`: the test couldn't run properly (e.g. its setup threw).

message.description: Failure or error message, e.g. `java.lang.ArithmeticException: / by zero`.
